name_zh: 古巴·菲德尔·卡斯特罗：革命导弹危机与医疗教育生存
name_en: Cuba Fidel Castro: Revolution Missile Crisis & Healthcare Education Survival
description_zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗 (1926-2016) 古巴革命领袖/总统 (1959-2008)，1959年推翻巴蒂斯塔，1962导弹危机核战争边缘，医疗教育免费全民覆盖，美国封锁六十年生存，2008年交权劳尔。
description_en: Fidel Castro (1926-2016) Cuba revolutionary leader/President (1959-2008), 1959 overthrew Batista, 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink, healthcare education free universal coverage, US blockade sixty years survival, 2008 handover Raul.
reason_zh: 卡斯特罗代表拉美革命如何在美帝国主义全方位封锁下生存六十年，展示了医疗教育成就如何成为革命合法性核心支柱，导弹危机将古巴推向核战争中心舞台，其长寿统治重塑拉美左翼想象。
reason_en: Castro represents how Latin American revolution survives sixty years under US comprehensive blockade, demonstrating how healthcare education achievements become revolutionary legitimacy core pillar, missile crisis placed Cuba at nuclear war center stage, his longevity rule reshaping Latin American left imagination.
steps_zh: 研究卡斯特罗早年律师与蒙卡达兵营起义
分析1959年革命胜利与土地改革/识字运动
探讨1962年导弹危机核战争边缘与古巴生存
评估医疗国际主义/教育免费/生物技术成就
总结革命导弹危机医疗教育古巴生存对拉美左翼的三重遗产
steps_en: Study Castro early lawyer and Moncada Barracks uprising
Analyze 1959 revolution victory and land reform/literacy campaign
Explore 1962 missile crisis nuclear war brink and Cuba survival
Summarize revolution missile crisis healthcare education Cuba survival triple legacy for Latin American left
expected_zh: 理解革命如何在封锁中通过人力资本投资实现人类发展指标超越，掌握导弹危机作为核威慑博弈的极限案例，评估卡斯特罗模式对委内瑞拉玻利维亚尼加拉瓜等左翼政权的示范与代价。
expected_en: Understand how revolution achieves human development indicators surpassing through human capital investment under blockade, grasp missile crisis as nuclear deterrence game limit case, evaluate Castro model demonstration and costs for Venezuela Bolivia Nicaragua left regimes.
case_zh: 1959 革命；1962 导弹；医疗教育免费；2008 交权；2016 逝世。革命导弹医疗教育生存范式永存。
case_en: 1959 revolution; 1962 missile crisis; healthcare education free; 2008 handover; 2016 death. Revolution missile healthcare education survival paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Cuban Revolutionary Socialism / Anti-Imperialism / Medical Internationalism
cross_cultural_impact: Revolution; missile crisis; healthcare; education; US blockade survival
